short_description: Husfeld et al. (1989) NLTE H-He atmospheres for hot helium-rich stars, Teff 35-80 kK (SVO Husfeld)
description: SVO's "Husfeld et al models for non-LTE Helium-rich stars": NLTE hydrogen-helium model atmospheres (Husfeld, Butler, Heber & Drilling 1989), Teff 35,000-80,000 K, log g 4.0-7.0, helium abundance Y(He) 0, 0.01, 0.10, 0.25, 0.35, 0.50 and 0.70. There is no metallicity axis: each Y(He) value is a variant with its own MESA cube.

notes: Shape check: no raw upstream copy of this grid exists on cirrus, and SVO refuses scripts, so the guard's shape check rests on every header declaring an unconverted original unit (flam). Rescaling: the spectra were cleaned in April 2026, when SED_Tools' cleaner rescaled spectra whose coarse 2,000-point blackbody ratio lay above 3 or below 0.1, without marking the file. Over this grid's 30 A - 3.3x10^7 A range such a rescaled spectrum would now integrate to 0.0002-0.002 of sigma*T^4; all 448 integrate to 0.83-1.03, so none was rescaled.
